{{Quote|I doubt it. That was just a mirror illusion I learned from the Fallanassi.|Jacen Solo|<ref name="Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>}}
The '''mirror illusion''' was a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] [[Fallanassi powers|technique]] which projected an illusion that varied according to the viewer. The user of the skill gave a general character to the illusion, but the specifics were filled in by the victim's mind. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] used a mirror illusion to bring his uncle [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] fear to the surface; Skywalker's mind created the rest of the illusion, viewing first his mother [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and then his wife [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] dying.
